existing_features.title: Create a responsive multi-section marketing website for the construction business named “Shree Aainath Construction”, with clear navigation and English user-facing copy.

Implement the following core content structure (single-page sections or separate routes are acceptable): Home (hero + key value proposition), About, Services, Projects (portfolio/gallery), and Contact (business contact details + inquiry form UI).

Add a coherent, construction-themed visual design system and apply it consistently across the site (colors, typography, spacing, button styles, and section styling). Do not use a blue/purple primary palette.
Add static asset handling for the required generated images by placing them under frontend/public/assets/generated and rendering them in the hero, logo/brand area, and projects gallery.
Ensure the website has basic SEO and accessibility essentials: correct document title, meta description, semantic headings, alt text for images, and keyboard-navigable links/buttons.
